_note: `$props` takes no type arguments (Svelte declares `function $props(): any`), so a type argument on the call is TS2558 "Expected 0 type arguments, but got 1" at the argument. svelte2tsx once moved a literal type argument into the `$$ComponentProps` alias and hid the error; svelte-check 4.7.7 leaves the call as written, types the props from the destructure as for an untyped `$props()`, and reports it.
